qa_audit.client_brand: John Paul the Great Academy (a Catholic classical school in Lafayette, Louisiana)
qa_audit.ip_note: The client is NOT fictional. The spec's own grounding_note states the brand is 'VERBATIM' from a real Upwork brief ('cand_52'): 'John Paul the Great Academy, a Catholic classical school in Lafayette, Louisiana' — a specific, named, geographically-pinned real religious institution whose name also invokes a real historical/religious figure (Pope John Paul II, 'John Paul the Great'). Real 'John Paul the Great' Catholic schools/academies exist. The benchmark requires the CLIENT to be an invented/fictional brand; using a verbatim real school (name + denomination + city + founding year 2006 + anniversary) violates that rule and carries real-org/trademark and sensitivity risk. Delivery-platform allowances (Upwork/Firefly) do not apply — the flagged entity is the client itself.
qa_audit.doable_note: No banned-capability violation (from-scratch folk-art art is correctly supplied as an approved input, not generated; image_fill_area is solid white preset fill; render_vector only exports the authored separations.ai; no text-to-image/gen-fill/object-removal/upscaling). But two connector-accuracy slips, both self-noted in reverify: step 7 image_vectorize has no maskURI param so the lettering_mask input is inert (it would trace the whole raster, not just lettering — an intermediate masked-raster step is needed); step 16 claims one render emits PDF+PNG+SVG when render_vector emits one media type per call (3 calls). Also loose print semantics: whole-layer gaussian blur isn't a true dot choke and tint/overlay on one shared field yields colored proofs, not independently-registering spot channels. Feasible as a headless job but not literally a press-ready 5-screen sep pack.
qa_audit.presentation_note: Spec is complete and well-formed: single specific deliverable (5-screen sep pack + vector lettering + grain proof + registration sheet + Firefly board), detailed full_brief, all inputs carry gen prompts and realism_notes, outputs carry specs, coherent 17-step output->input connector_workflow, chaining_note and reverify present. Minor internal inaccuracies (step 7 mask input inert; step 16 one-call-for-3-formats) are documented in reverify but not corrected in the workflow, so the chain as written is slightly non-executable at those two nodes.
